competing_hypotheses.statement: XRP derivatives positioning remains net long and vulnerable to liquidation cascades.
supporting_evidence: TradRadar reports 74.8% long accounts and $2.37M long liquidations.
disconfirming_evidence: Funding is only +0.0025% per eight hours on TradRadar; venue-level funding differs and some exchanges are negative.

competing_hypotheses.statement: A single aggregate funding or open-interest series is sufficient to infer market direction.
disconfirming_evidence: TradRadar, Kodexius and CoinGecko report materially different open-interest totals and funding snapshots.

competing_hypotheses.statement: ETF flows are providing persistent net demand despite short-term price weakness.
supporting_evidence: Five-day net flows reported at +$4.3M; cumulative inflows reported at +$1.81B.
disconfirming_evidence: October 30 recorded a small net outflow; ETF flows are not equivalent to net spot buying or unhedged exposure.
